# Fallout 76: New Appalachia map including Skyline Valley with all regions and locations

![Fallout 76: New Appalachia map including Skyline Valley with all regions and locations](/uploads/364_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

For the first time since 2018, today's Skyline Valley update now includes a map expansion. And this opens up a new area for us with new places and many new possibilities.

To give you a better overview, we have created this map for you. By clicking on the map, it opens in a new window in full resolution. When uploading, the resolution is usually reduced again, so it's best to pass on the link to this post for the best resolution of the card.

## Appalachia map with all regions

![Fallout 76 map with all regions including Skyline Valley](/uploads/skyline-valley-world-with-regions-2024-1280px.jpg) 

## Appalachia Map with Skyline Valley with all locations

![Appalachia map with Skyline Valley and all locations](/uploads/mappalachia-appalachia-skyline-valley-nukaknights-1280.jpeg) 

Additionally, our Skyline Valley map from the expected changes post is also available here.

## Skyline Valley map with random encounters

![Skyline Valley Map with Random Encounter Points](/uploads/nukaknights-skyline-valley-map-w-random-encounters.jpg)
